claim: In mm/swap_state.c, when zswap or xswap is active, swap_vma_readahead and swap_cluster_readahead synchronously load only the demanded order-0 folio via swap_cache_read_folio_sync, and collect speculative neighboring slots into a batch dispatched to a dedicated background workqueue (zswap_prefetch_wq). The background worker asynchronously allocates folios and calls zswap_load, warming the swap cache without stalling the faulting thread.
falsifier: Exact-tree review shows lost lifetime protection, incorrect slot conflict handling, or broken cache lookup fallback. Correctness, metadata spread <1%, and calibrated fast-tier screen independently gate execution.
